meta.title: Bet types covered by the strategy framework (all definitions verified against official sportsbook help pages / regulator)

rows.name: Single bet — point spread (ATS)
rows.definition: Handicap (+/-) applied to the final score; favorite must win by more than the line to cover; underdog covers by winning or losing by less; push = refund if the margin lands exactly on the number

rows.name: Single bet — moneyline
rows.definition: Wager on which team wins outright; margin does not matter; American 3-digit odds (e.g., -150 = risk $150 to win $100; +150 = risk $100 to win $150)

rows.name: Single bet — total (over/under)
rows.definition: Wager on whether the combined final score of both teams is over or under the posted number (e.g., O/U 47.5: 48+ wins the over, 47 or fewer wins the under)

rows.name: Player prop (proposition bet)
rows.definition: Wager on an individual player's performance or a specific in-game event not directly tied to the game outcome (e.g., QB passing yards over/under, anytime TD scorer); settled on official statistics

rows.name: Parlay (multi-game / traditional)
rows.definition: Two or more single wagers combined into one bet; every leg must win; one loss voids the whole ticket; a pushed leg is removed and odds recalculated; regulator definition of parlay card wager = outcomes of 2+ games or 2+ contingencies
rows.typical_price: Combined odds = product of leg odds

rows.name: Same-game parlay (SGP)
rows.definition: Parlay combining 2+ selections from a single game (spread/total/props); because legs are correlated, books price SGPs with correlation models and may restrict ‘too closely related’ combinations
rows.typical_price: Correlation-adjusted (not the naive product of leg odds)

rows.name: Player-prop parlay
rows.definition: Parlay built from multiple player-prop legs (may span games); same all-legs-must-win rule; correlated same-player/same-game legs can be restricted as related contingencies
rows.typical_price: Product of leg odds, subject to correlation restrictions

rows.name: Teaser
rows.definition: Parlay on spreads/totals where each line is adjusted (‘teased’) in the bettor's favor in exchange for lower payout odds

rows.name: Round robin
rows.definition: A series of parlays from one set of selections (e.g., 3-team round robin = three 2-team parlays + one 3-team parlay), so not every leg must win for a payout

rows.name: Live / in-game betting
rows.definition: Wagers placed after kickoff on live markets (game spread, moneyline, total, quarter/half markets, eligible player props)
